verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents developer building blocks: the Apps SDK, the REST/Connect APIs, the MCP server, Autofill and Bulk create. None of these is a user-definable rules or trigger engine that fires actions automatically on events. Comment syncing and audit logs are adjacent features and do not deliver event-triggered automation rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
